known_but_not_in_abstract: GAP -- 7 T: no abstract found that states a water T1 or T2 of human or animal disc at 7 T. PMID 21604210 (7 T lumbar spine, 5 volunteers) is qualitative only; PMID 32338812 (7 T bovine discs) measured T2 but gives no number in the abstract (only NP mass density 1.10 +/- 0.03 g/cm3); PMID 31710416 (7 T) reports proteoglycan (MRS) T2, not water; PMID 23818244 (7 T) is a gagCEST/pH phantom-porcine study. Any 7 T disc value would be unverified.

GAP -- quantitative MT: no abstract found reporting a bound-pool fraction, MT exchange rate or T2b for nucleus pulposus or annulus fibrosus (searches: 'bound pool', 'macromolecular', 'quantitative magnetization transfer', 'macromolecular proton fraction', 'MT saturation', 'cross-relaxation'). Only magnetization transfer RATIOS exist: PMID 38420211 (canine post-mortem, 3.0 T) gives NP MTR 16.459% (grade I), 18.888% (grade II), 22.813% (grade III) verbatim in its abstract; PMID 20677229, 31187047, 26123048, 42013085, 23633131, 9840835, 7899987 (0.1 T) describe MTR/MT-rate trends without numbers. found.search_log: All searches ran through cest_scout.skills.pubmed.search_pubmed (NCBI esearch with field=tiab, relevance sort, max 15-20) and full abstracts via pubmed._efetch(truncate_abstract=None); ~0.5 s between calls, no call failed. Because the skill ANDs every untagged word against title/abstract, long queries returned nothing and short 3-5 word queries were used. Roughly 85 queries in 6 rounds, e.g.: 'intervertebral disc T2 relaxation time 3 T nucleus pulposus'; 'intervertebral disc T1 relaxation'; 'intervertebral disc T2 relaxation nucleus pulposus' / '... annulus fibrosus'; 'intervertebral disc relaxation times'; 'intervertebral disc 1.5 T T2'; 'intervertebral disc 7 T' / '7T' / '7 Tesla spine' / 'ultra-high field intervertebral disc sodium' / 'intervertebral disc gagCEST 7 T'; 'intervertebral disc T1rho nucleus pulposus' / '... annulus fibrosus' / 'T1rho nucleus pulposus values' / 'T1ρ lumbar intervertebral disc' / 'T1rho relaxation intervertebral disc grade' / 'T1ρ Pfirrmann lumbar disc 3T' / 'cervical disc T1rho'; 'intervertebral disc magnetization transfer' / 'bound pool' / 'macromolecular' / 'MT ratio' / 'MTR degeneration' / 'MTR nucleus pulposus' / 'magnetisation transfer intervertebral disc' / 'MT saturation intervertebral disc' / 'quantitative magnetization transfer spine' / 'macromolecular proton fraction spine' / 'cross-relaxation intervertebral disc'; 'intervertebral disc water content T2' / '... T1rho' / 'nucleus pulposus water content age degeneration' / 'human lumbar disc water content age' / 'intervertebral disc proton density water content MRI' / 'disc water content gravimetric MRI'; 'nucleus pulposus T2 ms'; 'intervertebral disc T2 mapping healthy'; 'cervical disc T2 mapping' / 'cervical intervertebral disc T2 values healthy'; 'lumbar disc T1 mapping' / 'intervertebral disc T1 mapping'; 'intervertebral disc T1 T2 ex vivo'; 'disc T2 relaxation 1.5T Pfirrmann' / 'intervertebral disc T2 relaxation time 1.5'; animal: 'porcine/bovine/rat/mouse/rabbit/goat intervertebral disc T2 ...', 'intervertebral disc T2 relaxation 9.4 T', '... 11.7 T'; plus targeted title searches (Marinelli, Antoniou, Blumenkrantz, Auerbach, Paajanen, Tertti). 342 unique PMIDs were seen; 158 full abstracts were fetched and read (screened for ms values, ±, % and field strength). Records were kept only where a number appears in the abstract; each quote was then re-extracted byte-exact from the fetched abstract (thin/no-break spaces preserved), checked as an exact substring, and passed through the project's own gates: pubmed.verify_quote = 22/22 unique quotes verified, pubmed.verify_titles = 20/20 PMIDs verified. Value strings were written one number-group per ';' segment so build_tissue_reference.parse_number can read them; one-sided cut-offs ('>62.03 ms') are kept as stated even though the parser will flag them as comparative. Yield: 20 distinct on-topic abstracts with numbers -> 65 records (63 human in vivo, 1 rat in vivo, 1 human ex vivo biochemistry). records.title: T2 relaxation time is related to liver fibrosis severity.

records.notes: Fibrosis groups: mild 66.7±1.9 (n=30), moderate 71.6±1.7 (n=26), severe 72.4±1.4 ms (n=61).

records.title: T2 relaxation time is related to liver fibrosis severity.

records.title: Evaluation of liver fibrosis with T2 relaxation time in infants with cholestasis: comparison with normal controls.

known_but_not_in_abstract: PMID 16086319 (Stanisz et al. 2005, 'T1, T2 relaxation and magnetization transfer in tissue at 3T'): abstract states NO numbers. It reports only qualitatively that T1 increased with field, T2 and qMT parameters (MT exchange rate R, macromolecular pool fraction M0B, macromolecular T2B) at 3 T were similar to 1.5 T, and MTR was lower by ~2-10%. The tabulated 1.5 T and 3 T T1/T2/R/M0B/T2B values for mouse liver, mouse muscle and rat kidney (in vitro, 37 degrees C) exist only in the paper's Table -- UNVERIFIED from abstract; do not use without full-text confirmation.

PMID 14990831 (de Bazelaire et al. 2004): abstract states 3.0 T values (all quoted above) but gives NO 1.5 T numbers, although measurements were also performed at 1.5 T on the same six volunteers. The 1.5 T T1/T2 for kidney cortex, medulla, liver, spleen, pancreas, paravertebral muscle, L4 marrow and fat are in the paper's tables only -- UNVERIFIED from abstract.

PMID 15269023 (Gold et al. 2004, 'Musculoskeletal MRI at 3.0 T: relaxation times and image contrast'): muscle, marrow and fat T1/T2 at 1.5 T and 3.0 T (five healthy volunteers, knee) are in tables only; abstract gives directions of change but no numbers -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 28959212 (Cox et al. 2017, multiparametric renal MRI, 127 healthy participants): renal cortex/medulla T1 at 1.5 T and 3 T stated to be 'in-line with literature values' and longer at 3 T, but no numbers in abstract -- values in tables only, UNVERIFIED.

PMID 30171825 (renal native T1 mapping reproducibility at 3 T, MOLLI 5(3)3, 15 healthy volunteers): abstract gives limits of agreement (e.g. -124/+82 msec) but not the cortex/medulla T1 values themselves -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 38380700 (renal T2 mapping harmonization, StimFit, 3 T, healthy travelling volunteers): cortex and medulla T2 values are compared between vendors but not stated numerically in the abstract -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 33067515 (MR fingerprinting of the pancreas at 1.5 T and 3.0 T, 16 healthy participants): abstract gives only relative statements (pancreatic T1 37-43% lower than muscle, spleen and kidney; pancreatic T2 nearly 40% lower at 1.5 T and <12% lower at 3.0 T); absolute T1/T2 in tables only -- UNVERIFIED.
PMID 32153416 (multiparametric mapping of pancreatic disease; 29 healthy volunteers, MOLLI T1, T2-prep): control pancreas T1/T2/ADC not given numerically in abstract -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 2991980 (Bottomley-era canine field dependence, 0.3-1.5 T, muscle/kidney cortex/spleen/adipose): abstract gives only the T1-vs-field slope (400-500 msec/T for water-dominated tissues, ~150 msec/T for adipose) and states T2 is field independent; absolute T1/T2 values are in figures/tables only -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 22334510 (mouse liver T1/T2 at 7 T, CCl4 fibrosis model) and PMID 15580375 (rat liver and metastasis T1/T2 at 7 T): both abstracts report significant changes but no absolute values -- UNVERIFIED.
PMID 41521503 (qMT bound pool fraction f and MTR in kidney-transplant recipients and 31 healthy volunteers at 1.5 T and 3.0 T): abstract gives no numeric f for healthy cortex/medulla -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 18097273 (MTR at 0.2/1.5/3.0 T in liver, kidney, spleen, muscle, brain, cartilage; 3 volunteers) and PMID 24962475 (free-breathing MTR of liver, pancreas, kidney, spleen, paraspinal muscle; 7 volunteers): MTR values are not stated numerically in the abstracts (and MTR is not one of the requested qMT parameters) -- UNVERIFIED.

PMID 39414686 (free-breathing qRF-MRF at 3 T; liver, spleen, pancreas, kidney cortex/medulla, paravertebral muscle in 10 healthy volunteers): abstract reports agreement with clinical standards but no numeric T1/T2 -- UNVERIFIED.
PMID 17763345 (oxygen/carbogen effect on T1 of liver, spleen, skeletal muscle, renal cortex, fat in 16 healthy volunteers): baseline T1 values not stated in abstract -- UNVERIFIED.
found.search_log: Tool: cest_scout.skills.pubmed (search_pubmed with field=tiab default, _efetch with truncate_abstract=None for full abstracts; ~0.5-0.6 s between calls; no call failed). Started by fetching PMID 14990831 and 16086319 in full: de Bazelaire's abstract carries the complete 3.0 T table (quoted); Stanisz's abstract carries no numbers (listed as known_but_not_in_abstract). Five search batches (~65 queries total), e.g.: 'liver T1 relaxation time 3 T healthy volunteers'; 'liver T2 relaxation time 1.5 T 3 T'; 'abdominal organs relaxation times 1.5 T 3 T'; 'kidney cortex medulla T1 relaxation time 3 T'; 'renal cortex T2 relaxation time MRI'; 'spleen T1 T2 relaxation time'; 'pancreas T1 relaxation time 3 T'; 'skeletal muscle T1 T2 relaxation time 3 T'; 'abdominal relaxation times 7 T'; 'liver T1 7 T relaxation'; 'renal T1 mapping healthy volunteers cortex medulla'; 'renal cortex medulla T1 7 T human'; 'quantitative magnetization transfer liver/kidney/muscle/pancreas/spleen'; 'macromolecular proton fraction liver/kidney'; 'bound pool fraction' variants (returned nothing with long phrases -- the wrapper matches title/abstract text, so queries were shortened); 'magnetization transfer ratio liver spleen kidney'; 'liver T1 mapping healthy volunteers'; 'liver T2 mapping healthy volunteers'; 'spleen T2 relaxation'; 'splenic T1 mapping'; 'pancreatic T2 relaxation time'; 'pancreas T1 relaxation time healthy volunteers'; 'muscle T2 relaxation time 1.5 T'; 'thigh muscle T1 relaxation time'; 'calf muscle T2 relaxation time healthy'; 'kidney T1 mapping 1.5 T'; 'renal cortex T1 relaxation 1.5 T'; 'kidney T2 mapping healthy volunteers'; 'renal cortex medulla T2 values'; 'MR fingerprinting liver T1 T2'; 'ex vivo liver T1 T2 relaxation 3 T'; 'porcine/bovine liver relaxation'; 'mouse liver T2 relaxation time 7 T'; 'rat kidney T1 T2 relaxation in vivo 7 T'; 'shMOLLI liver'; 'human liver 7 T T1 mapping in vivo'; 'skeletal muscle T1 T2 7 T human'. ~110 candidate abstracts fetched in full and read; 40 distinct PMIDs yielded quotable numbers -> 117 records (105 human in vivo, 8 animal in vivo, 4 ex vivo). Every quote was extracted programmatically as a verbatim slice of the fetched abstract text (NBSP characters preserved) and then passed through the project's own gates: pubmed.verify_titles (40/40 verified) and pubmed.verify_quote (50/50 distinct quotes verified live against PubMed). Coverage by tissue: liver -- T1/T2 at 1.5 T (6 papers incl. n=100 normal-range study), 3 T (7 papers), 7 T (2 papers), 5 T (1), plus MPF (2) and T1rho (1); renal cortex and medulla -- T1/T2 at 3 T (5 papers), 7 T (2 papers), 1.5 T T1 (2 papers, cortex; medulla sex-stratified in 1), 5 T (1), qMT bound-pool fraction only in swine (3 T) and mouse (16.4 T); spleen -- T1 at 1.5 T (2), 3 T (3), 7 T (1), T2 at 3 T (1) plus MRF (field not stated); pancreas -- T1 at 1.5 T (3), 3 T (6), T2 at 3 T (3), 5 T (1), no 7 T; skeletal muscle -- T1/T2 at 3 T (3 papers), 7 T T1 (1), 1.5 T only a coarse '1 second' T1, qMT (T2b 5.9 us, f 8%) at 3 T (1), 50 mT (1). Honest gaps (no abstract-level numbers found): human renal T2 at 1.5 T; spleen T2 at 1.5 T; pancreas T2 at 1.5 T; precise adult muscle T1/T2 at 1.5 T; any MT exchange rate (k or R) for any abdominal tissue; MT T2b for liver/kidney/spleen/pancreas; human qMT for kidney/spleen/pancreas; all 7 T pancreas values. Notable caveats recorded in notes: Chen 2016 MRF abdominal values (PMID 26794935) have no field strength in the abstract; renal T2 varies 2-3x between sequences at 3 T (47-76 ms vs 121-140 ms); PMID 28081721 (splenic T1) has a PubMed Editorial Expression of Concern; several 'control' cohorts are patients without the disease under study rather than healthy volunteers, as marked. Scratch artifacts: /tmp/claude-1251753/-home-wangk6-CEST-Scout/7fdc92ab-e5ed-48d1-927c-f40660a49618/scratchpad/records.json (final records), full1-5.json (cached abstracts), build_records.py (extraction + verification script).

PMID 12815682 Tozer 2003, PMID 12814170 Davies 2003 and PMID 15584482 Davies 2004: bound proton fraction f and T2B for control WM, NAWM, NAGM and MS lesions in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 22190042 Yarnykh 2012 (single-point MPF), PMID 32676363 Yarnykh 2020 (0.5 T), PMID 39251498 (0.3 T), PMID 26102097 (2016 3D MPF), PMID 31737961 (scan-rescan MPF): human WM/GM MPF values in tables only; abstracts give only agreement/repeatability statistics. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 29676026 (SIR qMT at 7 T with postmortem validation), PMID 32004710 (whole-brain 3D SIR), PMID 36352756 (SIR with CS-SENSE), PMID 29573356 (SIR optimization): PSR, R1f and kmf values in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 25066274 Li 2014 (healthy human thigh muscles at 3.0 T, nine subjects) and PMID 25839394 Li 2015 (thigh qMT, controls and polymyositis): muscle PSR / F values in tables only; PMID 24777935 (murine skeletal muscle inflammation) likewise reports PSR only in tables. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 39155273 (lower-leg muscles, 31 young vs 20 older women, 3 T UTE-MT): MMF and macromolecular T2 (T2-MM) values in tables; abstract gives only relative age differences (MMF -17 to -19%). PMID 41003486 (calf muscle macromolecular fraction, young vs senior, 3 T) and PMID 36900019 (bovine muscle phantom MMF vs fat fraction) also give no absolute MMF in the abstract. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 31355979 Wang 2019 (murine kidney tubulointerstitial fibrosis, 7 T), PMID 28736875 (mouse unilateral ureter obstruction, 7 T), PMID 35704387 (mouse IRI, 7 T), PMID 37093746 (mouse PKD, 7 T), PMID 37881827 (rat IRI-AKI, 7 T): renal cortex/medulla PSR values in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 41521503 (kidney transplant recipients, 1.5 T and 3.0 T) and PMID 42402669 (renovascular disease, 1.5 T and 3.0 T): human renal cortex and medulla qMT bound-pool fraction f measured but no numeric f in either abstract. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 20373391 Dula 2010 (excised fixed rat spinal cord white-matter tracts qMT), PMID 17659607 Portnoy 2007 (mouse spinal cord M0B and T2B), PMID 22664569 (shaking pup brain f), PMID 21029782 Underhill 2011 (rat brain CRI at 3.0 T; abstract gives only glioma f = 3.9-4.0%, normal WM/GM f in tables), PMID 27646128 (rat brain two-pool parameters at 11.7 T incl. MPF, cross-relaxation rate and T2 of pools): values in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 21416504 (cross-relaxation imaging of human ex vivo knee cartilage), PMID 31713936 (3D UTE-Cones knee joint tissues, f for 15 volunteers 'were reported' but not in abstract), PMID 34904305 (enzymatically digested human cartilage MMF), PMID 39197467 (osteochondral junction MMF ex vivo), PMID 33147490 (cartilage MMF and T2mm vs mechanics), PMID 20573130-class bSSFP patellar cartilage qMT (PMID 20572130): cartilage bound-pool fraction / k / T2B in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

INTERVERTEBRAL DISC: no abstract found at any field strength reporting a qMT bound pool fraction, exchange rate or bound-pool T2 for nucleus pulposus or annulus fibrosus. Only semi-quantitative MTR studies exist (PMID 20677229 human lumbar MTR mapping; PMID 9840835 and PMID 23633131 human discs ex vivo; PMID 16778686 bovine coccygeal NP at 1.5 T; PMID 42013085 canine post-mortem MTR; PMID 33475842 and PMID 42286353 semi-solid MT amplitude from disc Z-spectra) and none of these states a number in its abstract. The pipeline must therefore say 'unknown' for disc MT parameters rather than borrow a value.

Adjacent tissues found but outside this group (kept for reference only): PMID 30986332 bovine cortical bone at 4.7 T -- collagen methylene proton fraction 22-28%, collagen proton T2 11 microseconds (ex vivo); PMID 33201524 human left-ventricular myocardium PSR 4.30 ± 0.65% (10 healthy subjects).
found.search_log: Tool: cest_scout.skills.pubmed (_esearch with field=tiab, sort=relevance, retmax 15; _efetch with truncate_abstract=None for full abstracts), run from the CEST_Scout conda env on the HPC login node with 0.5 s pauses between calls and a 3 s retry on exceptions (no exceptions occurred). ~85 distinct queries over 7 batches, e.g. 'quantitative magnetization transfer <tissue>', '<tissue> bound pool fraction', '<tissue> macromolecular proton fraction', 'pool size ratio', 'cross-relaxation imaging', 'qMT <tissue>', 'restricted pool fraction', 'two-pool model fraction', 'ultrashort echo time magnetization transfer <tissue>', field-specific variants (1.5 T, 3 T, 7 T, 0.5 T), disc-specific variants (nucleus pulposus / annulus fibrosus / cartilaginous endplate / spine UTE-MT), and title searches for classics (Morrison & Henkelman 1995, Sled & Pike 2001, Ramani 2002, Tozer 2003, Schmierer 2007, Yarnykh 2012, Dula 2010, shaking pup 2012). 272 unique PubMed records were cached (scratchpad qmt_hits.json). Abstracts were screened by regex for qMT keywords co-occurring with numbers, then every candidate was read in full (three passes, 75 + 64 + 23 abstracts, plus 19 remaining disc/muscle/spine abstracts). Only numbers printed in the abstract text were recorded; quotes were copied verbatim. Gate: all 30 cited PMIDs passed pubmed.verify_titles (title matches PubMed) and all 39 unique quotes passed pubmed.verify_quote (0 failures). Yield by tissue (abstracts with numeric qMT values): brain WM/GM 13 human + 2 animal abstracts (15325389, 21608030, 22940589, 31081239, 31762101, 26018987, 11050646, 31233908, 20960580, 17659567, 25768108, 7776877, 24338993, 32767495); spinal cord 5 (19097204 at 1.5 T, 24632465 at 3 T, 28921614, 25960050 monkey 9.4 T, 31125149 ex vivo relative change); skeletal muscle 4 (20665899 at 3 T, 33201524, 37828713 rat 3 T, 7776877); liver 3 (26503401 at 3 T, 35753084 at 3 T incl. T1rho, 7776877) -- fewer than 5 exist with abstract numbers; kidney 2 (32964585 mouse 16.4 T, 34935650 swine 3 T) -- all animal, human kidney qMT papers give no abstract numbers; cartilage 4 (25278066 CRI 3 T with f, k, T2B; 33894091, 40558797, 42192057 UTE-MT MMF); intervertebral disc 0 -- no qMT abstract exists, only MTR studies without numbers. Caveats for table users: (1) conventions differ -- PSR (M0b/M0f), f/BPF/MPF (M0b/(M0b+M0f)), MMF (UTE-MT), Fr (ZAPPED phenomenological), and exchange rates are variously kmf/R (bound-to-free) or k/kf/kFB (free-to-bound); values are copied as stated and not converted; (2) several abstracts omit field strength, recorded as 'not stated in abstract'; (3) fixation raises bound pool fraction by ~30-40% (31125149) and fat contamination lowers UTE-MT MMF by ~5 percentage points (42192057).

UNVERIFIED (table-only). Note: in vitro bovine tissue at 37 C, not human in vivo.

PMID 11675644 (Sled & Pike 2001, 'Quantitative imaging of magnetization transfer exchange and relaxation properties in vivo using MRI'): WM/GM restricted-pool fraction, exchange rate and restricted-pool T2 at 1.5 T are in tables/figures only; abstract has no numbers. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 14755655 (Sled 2004, 'Regional variations in normal brain shown by quantitative magnetization transfer imaging'): regional pool sizes, exchange and relaxation parameters (7 normal subjects, 1.5 T) in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 15978842 (Cercignani 2005, 'Three-dimensional quantitative magnetisation transfer imaging of the human brain'): two-pool qMT values in several brain locations (6 healthy) in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 12591568 (Ramani 2002, 'Precise estimate of fundamental in-vivo MT parameters in human brain in clinically feasible times'): WM (occipital, frontal, centrum semiovale) and GM (cortex, cerebellum) MT parameters in tables only. UNVERIFIED.
PMID 18727085 (Gloor 2008, 'Quantitative magnetization transfer imaging using balanced SSFP'): WM/GM fractional pool size F, exchange rate kf, T1, T2 at 1.5 T in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 21820061 (Garcia 2012, 'Fast high-resolution brain imaging with balanced SSFP: Interpretation of quantitative magnetization transfer towards simple MTR'): F, kf, T1, T2 and MTR for 12 WM and 11 GM structures (12 healthy volunteers) in tables only. UNVERIFIED.
PMID 20572130 (Gloor 2010, 'Nonbalanced SSFP-based quantitative magnetization transfer imaging'): in vivo human patellar cartilage two-pool qMT parameters in tables only. UNVERIFIED.

PMID 15971174 (Lu 2005, 'Routine clinical brain MRI sequences for use at 3.0 Tesla'): GM/WM T1 and T2 at 1.5 T and 3.0 T (10 healthy subjects) in tables; abstract gives only relative change (T1 14-30% longer, T2 12-19% shorter at 3.0 T vs 1.5 T). UNVERIFIED.

PMID 11948736 (Bartha 2002, 'In vivo 1H2O T2+ measurement in the human occipital lobe at 4T and 7T by Carr-Purcell MRI'): absolute GM/WM T2+ at 4 T and 7 T in tables; abstract states only that GM T2+ was 19% (4 T) and 9% (7 T) smaller than WM. PMID 33118238 (2021, 'In vivo investigation of the multi-exponential T2 decay in human white matter at 7 T'): compartmental WM T2 times at 7 T and 3 T in figures/tables only. UNVERIFIED.
PMID 17459640 (Peters 2007, 'T2* measurements in human brain at 1.5, 3 and 7 T'): GM/WM T2* per field in tables only (and T2* is outside the schema). UNVERIFIED.
PMID 8978630 (Whittall 1997): the records above are abstract-verified, but the field strength (1.5 T in the full text) is NOT stated in the abstract; recorded as 'not stated in abstract'.

PMID 15325389 (Yarnykh 2004 cross-relaxation imaging): f and k records above are abstract-verified, but the field strength (1.5 T in the full text) is NOT stated in the abstract; recorded as 'not stated in abstract'.

UNVERIFIED for schema parameters.

Brain MT_T2b (bound-pool T2 in microseconds) for WM/GM: NOT FOUND in any abstract at any field strength in this search (sources such as Stanisz 2005, Sled & Pike 2001, Cercignani 2005, Ramani 2002, Yarnykh 2002 hold it only in tables). Report as 'don't know' rather than asserting a value.

Meniscus T1 in vivo at any field: NOT FOUND in any abstract (ex vivo 9.4 T values from PMID 30552967 are the only abstract-verified meniscus T1). Meniscus MT parameters: none found in abstracts (PMID 33289401 reports only % change in MMF under load, ex vivo).

(meniscus) 'meniscus T2 relaxation time 3 T knee', 'meniscus T1 T2 relaxation times ultrashort echo time', 'meniscus T2* 7 T', 'meniscus T1 relaxation 3 T UTE in vivo', 'meniscus T2 7 T in vivo knee'; (tendon) 'Achilles tendon T2* relaxation time UTE 3 T', 'tendon T1 relaxation time UTE in vivo', 'patellar tendon T2* UTE', 'tendon relaxation times 7 T UTE', 'tendon magnetization transfer ratio UTE', 'tendon quantitative magnetization transfer macromolecular fraction UTE', 'Achilles tendon T1 relaxation 3 T UTE healthy volunteers', 'Achilles tendon T2* 1.5 T'; (brain) 'brain white matter gray matter T1 relaxation time 3 T healthy', 'brain T1 T2 relaxation times 7 T', 'Wansapura NMR relaxation times human brain 3.0 tesla', 'magnetic field and tissue dependencies of human brain longitudinal 1H2O relaxation', 'water proton T1 measurements in brain tissue at 7, 3, and 1.5 T', 'T2 relaxation times human brain 7 T (several wordings)', 'in vivo 1H2O T2 measurement human occipital lobe 4T 7T', 'in vivo measurement of T2 distributions and water contents in normal human brain', 'high-resolution T1 and T2 mapping DESPOT1 DESPOT2', 'brain transverse relaxation rates 3.0 T', 'interregional variation of longitudinal relaxation rates 3.0 T', 'routine clinical brain MRI sequences for use at 3.0 Tesla', 'normal relaxation times of tissues at 3T review', 'quantitative magnetization transfer brain white matter bound pool fraction 3 T', 'quantitative magnetization transfer human brain macromolecular pool exchange rate T2b', 'quantitative magnetization transfer imaging human brain white matter pool size ratio', 'Sled Pike quantitative imaging of magnetization transfer exchange and relaxation', 'cross-relaxation imaging bound pool fraction white matter gray matter', 'quantitative magnetization transfer imaging using balanced SSFP', 'pulsed Z-spectroscopic imaging of cross-relaxation parameters', 'regional variations in normal brain shown by quantitative magnetization transfer imaging', 'direct quantitative comparison between cross-relaxation imaging and DTI 3.0 T', 'magnetization transfer phenomenon in the human brain at 7 T', 'fast macromolecular proton fraction mapping', 'magnetization transfer ratio white matter gray matter healthy 3 T', 'T1, T2 relaxation and magnetization transfer in tissue at 3T' (Stanisz). Verification: all 58 unique quotes were passed through pubmed.verify_quote (58/58 verified) and all 39 PMID/title pairs through pubmed.verify_titles (39/39 verified) before inclusion. Coverage per tissue group (distinct on-topic abstracts contributing numeric records): cartilage 12 (3 T: 24594416, 17307365, 21394766, 20633680, 20019141, 25278066, 31844957; 7 T: 26971422, 18708855, 27112156; 1.5 T: 19723767), meniscus 5 (18936315, 31844957, 30888480, 33983499 ex vivo, 30552967 ex vivo 9.4 T), tendon 11 (31351110, 37740595, 30457179 ex vivo, 32003317, 22851221 [3 T and 7 T], 28263448, 28717625, 31131911, 30693600, 21986866, 29219218 ex vivo), brain 14 (10232510, 18259791 [1.5/3/7 T], 17260370, 40714992, 11146488, 10207479, 21394766, 8978630, 32885296, 27594531, 21608030, 22940589, 15325389, 8585499). Honest gaps: no abstract-verified in vivo brain water T2 at 7 T; no abstract-verified brain or tendon MT_T2b; no abstract-verified 1.5 T human cartilage T2; no in vivo meniscus T1; no 1.5 T tendon values; hip cartilage at 3 T has no abstract numbers (only 7 T). Tendon 'T2' records are UTE T2* (or MRF/T1rho) and are labelled as such in value/notes; brain 3 T R1/R2 records from Gelman 1999/2001 are left as rates, not converted. MTR and PSR entries are placed under MT_fraction with explicit labels because the schema has no MTR/PSR fields; they are not bound-pool fractions.
